FRAME.content:
# Multi-Cluster Kubernetes Architecture

## Design Overview
Primary cluster: us-east-1
Secondary cluster: eu-west-1

## Failover Strategy
- Automatic health checks every 10 seconds
- DNS-based traffic routing with TTL 30 seconds
- Service mesh (Istio) for canary deployments
- Data replication with RPO 5 minutes

## High Availability
Target: 99.99% uptime
RTO: < 5 minutes for cluster failover
RPO: < 5 minutes for data loss

2. Secondary cluster configuration (eu-west-1)
   - 3 master nodes, 3 worker nodes
   - Standby auto-scaling enabled

3. Service mesh (Istio 1.14)
   - Cross-cluster communication configured
   - Canary traffic splitting implemented

4. DNS and traffic management
   - Route53 health checks active
   - Automatic failover validated
